## ClientMsg  (type-only)
type ClientMsg<GHello = unknown, GCommand = unknown, GInterest = unknown, GInput = unknown, GClient = unknown> = {
    type: 'Hello';
    token: string;
    schemaHash: string;
    bulk: number | null;
    ext: GHello;
} | {
    type: 'Command';
    seq: number;
    command: GCommand;
} | {
    type: 'Subscribe';
    sub: number;
    query: string;
    args: Uint8Array;
    resume: {
        version: number;
        hash: string;
    } | null;
} | {
    type: 'Unsubscribe';
    sub: number;
} | {
    type: 'Ping';
    clientTime: number;
} | {
    type: 'SetInterest';
    interest: GInterest;
} | {
    type: 'Input';
    seq: number;
    input: GInput;
} | {
    type: 'TakeControl';
} | {
    type: 'EntityResync';
} | {
    type: 'Ack';
    bytes: number;
} | {
    type: 'Game';
    value: GClient;
};

## Codec  (type-only)
interface Codec<T = unknown> {
    encode(w: Writer, value: T): void;
    decode(r: Reader): T;
}

    get entities(): ReadonlyMap<number, V>;

    get waiting(): boolean;
    get(id: number): V | undefined;

}

## Fixed
class Fixed {
    static readonly FRAC_BITS = 32;
    static readonly ZERO: Fixed;
    static readonly ONE: Fixed;
    static readonly MIN: Fixed;
    static readonly MAX: Fixed;
    readonly bits: bigint;
    constructor(bits: bigint);
    static fromBits(bits: bigint): Fixed;
    static fromInt(n: number | bigint): Fixed;
    static parse(text: string): Fixed;
    floor(): number;
    compare(other: Fixed): -1 | 0 | 1;
    equals(other: Fixed): boolean;
    toNumber(): number;
    toString(): string;
    toJSON(): string;
}

## Net
class Net {
    readonly schema: NetSchema;
    readonly clock: NetClock;
    readonly snapshots: SnapshotBuffer;
    readonly entities: EntityStream | null;
    constructor(options: NetOptions);
    get status(): NetStatus;
    get welcome(): Welcome | null;
    get ready(): Promise<Welcome>;
    get driving(): boolean;
    get attempts(): number;
    on<E extends keyof NetEvents>(event: E, listener: (...args: NetEvents[E]) => void): () => void;
    command<R = unknown>(command: unknown): Promise<R>;
    query<T = unknown>(name: string, args: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined, listener: (value: T, patch: readonly PatchOp[] | null) => void, options?: QueryOptions): LiveQuery<T>;
    setInterest(interest: unknown): void;
    send(value: unknown): boolean;
    takeControl(): void;
    predict<State, Input>(options: PredictorOptions<State, Input>): Predictor<State, Input>;
    input(input: unknown): boolean;
    optimistic<K, V>(store: OptimisticStore<K, V>, equal?: (a: V, b: V) => boolean): Optimistic<K, V>;
    wake(): void;
    reconnect(): void;
    close(): void;
}

## NetClock
class NetClock {
    constructor(time: number, paused: boolean, stepMs?: number, local?: () => number);
    get paused(): boolean;
    get latencyMs(): number;
    get stepMs(): number;
    now(at?: number): number;
    observe(time: number, paused: boolean, latencyMs?: number): void;
    reset(time: number, paused: boolean, stepMs: number): void;
}

## NetEvents  (type-only)
interface NetEvents {
    welcome: [welcome: Welcome];
    rejected: [reason: string, stale: boolean];
    down: [code: number, reason: string];
    closed: [code: number, reason: string];
    game: [value: unknown];
    entities: [changes: EntityChanges];
    interestRejected: [reason: string];
    control: [driving: boolean];
    state: [seq: number, state: unknown];
    error: [error: Error];
}

## NetOptions  (type-only)
interface NetOptions {
    readonly schema: NetSchema;
    readonly connect: Connect;
    readonly hello?: Hello | (() => Hello);
    readonly reconnect?: ReconnectOptions | false;
    readonly liveness?: LivenessOptions;
    readonly handshakeMs?: number;
    readonly commandMs?: number;
    readonly inflate?: (codec: number, data: Uint8Array) => Promise<Uint8Array>;
    readonly bulk?: number;
    readonly entities?: string;
    readonly snapshots?: SnapshotBufferOptions;
    readonly timers?: Timers;
    readonly random?: () => number;
}

## NetSchema
class NetSchema {
    readonly text: string;
    readonly hash: string;
    readonly roots: readonly string[];
    readonly types: Types;
    readonly queries: ReadonlyMap<string, QueryDef>;
    constructor(header: string, desc: TypesDesc);
    variants(name: string): readonly string[];
    fields(name: string): readonly {
        readonly wire: string;
        readonly prop: string;
        readonly ty: TypeRef;
    }[];
    codec<T = unknown>(ty: TypeSpec): Codec<T>;
    encode(ty: TypeSpec, value: unknown): Uint8Array;
    decode<T = unknown>(ty: TypeSpec, bytes: Uint8Array): T;
    encodeArgs(query: string, args: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined): Uint8Array;
}

## NetStatus  (type-only)
type NetStatus = 'connecting' | 'open' | 'down' | 'closed';

## Optimistic
class Optimistic<K, V> {
    rollbacks: number;
    constructor(store: OptimisticStore<K, V>, equal?: (a: V, b: V) => boolean);
    get size(): number;
    has(key: K): boolean;
    confirmed(key: K): V | undefined;
    edit(key: K, value: V): (accepted: boolean) => boolean;
    run(key: K, value: V, send: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<boolean>;
    confirm(key: K, value: V): void;
    clear(): void;
}

## OptimisticStore  (type-only)
interface OptimisticStore<K, V> {
    read(key: K): V | undefined;
    write(key: K, value: V): void;
}

    constructor(message: string);

## PatchOp  (type-only)
type PatchOp = {
    readonly type: 'Set';
    readonly path: readonly PathStep[];
    readonly value: Uint8Array;
} | {
    readonly type: 'MapPut';
    readonly path: readonly PathStep[];
    readonly key: Uint8Array;
    readonly value: Uint8Array;
} | {
    readonly type: 'MapRemove';
    readonly path: readonly PathStep[];
    readonly key: Uint8Array;
};

## PathStep  (type-only)
type PathStep = {
    readonly type: 'Field';
    readonly index: number;
} | {
    readonly type: 'Variant';
    readonly variant: number;
    readonly field: number;
} | {
    readonly type: 'Entry';
    readonly key: Uint8Array;
} | {
    readonly type: 'Present';
};

## Predictor
class Predictor<State, Input> {
    readonly corrections: Correction[];
    correctionCount: number;
    resets: number;
    readonly roundTrips: number[];
    constructor(options: PredictorOptions<State, Input>);
    get state(): State;
    get previous(): State;
    get seq(): number;
    get pending(): number;
    apply(input: Input): number;
    acknowledge(seq: number, state: State): Correction | null;
    follow(seq: number, state: State): void;
    expectReset(): void;
    clear(): void;
    correctionsWithin(ms?: number): number;
    alpha(now?: number): number;
}

## PredictorOptions  (type-only)
interface PredictorOptions<State, Input> {
    readonly step: (state: State, input: Input) => State;
    readonly equal: (a: State, b: State) => boolean;
    readonly distance?: (a: State, b: State) => number;
    readonly start: {
        readonly seq: number;
        readonly state: State;
    };
    readonly stepMs?: number;
    readonly now?: () => number;
}

## ServerMsg  (type-only)
type ServerMsg<GWelcome = unknown, GResult = unknown, GState = unknown, GServer = unknown> = {
    type: 'Welcome';
    player: number;
    time: number;
    paused: boolean;
    stepUs: number;
    ext: GWelcome;
} | {
    type: 'Rejected';
    reason: string;
    staleSchema: boolean;
} | {
    type: 'CommandResult';
    seq: number;
    result: GResult;
} | {
    type: 'Update';
    sub: number;
    version: number;
    hash: string;
    patch: PatchOp[];
} | {
    type: 'Resync';
    sub: number;
    version: number;
    result: Uint8Array;
} | {
    type: 'QueryFailed';
    sub: number;
    reason: string;
} | {
    type: 'Clock';
    time: number;
    paused: boolean;
} | {
    type: 'Pong';
    clientTime: number;
    time: number;
    paused: boolean;
} | {
    type: 'InterestRejected';
    reason: string;
} | {
    type: 'EntityStream';
    data: Uint8Array;
} | {
    type: 'PlayerState';
    seq: number;
    state: GState;
    tickUs: number;
} | {
    type: 'Control';
    driving: boolean;
} | {
    type: 'Closed';
    code: number;
    reason: string;
} | {
    type: 'Bulk';
    codec: number;
    data: Uint8Array;
} | {
    type: 'Game';
    value: GServer;
};

## SnapshotBuffer
class SnapshotBuffer {
    readonly dims: number;
    readonly stepMs: number;
    constructor(options?: SnapshotBufferOptions);
    get delay(): number;
    get jitter(): number;
    get size(): number;
    has(id: number): boolean;
    push(id: number, step: number, pos: ArrayLike<number>, vel: ArrayLike<number>, now: number, snap?: boolean): void;
    remove(id: number): void;
    clear(): void;
    frame(now: number): void;
    at(id: number, out: {
        [i: number]: number;
    }): boolean;
    velocity(id: number, out: {
        [i: number]: number;
    }): boolean;
    latest(id: number, out: {
        [i: number]: number;
    }): boolean;
}

## SnapshotBufferOptions  (type-only)
interface SnapshotBufferOptions {
    readonly dims?: 2 | 3;
    readonly stepMs?: number;
    readonly capacity?: number;
    readonly minDelayMs?: number;
    readonly maxDelayMs?: number;
    readonly blendMax?: number;
    readonly blendMsPerUnit?: number;
    readonly jump?: number;
}

type TypeRef = Scalar | {
